Elsa CSM: FYI - NorthBridge trial usage collapsed from ~25k tok/day to 120 tokens overnight after they paused the pilot pending procurement review. Risking renewal.
Tom AE: They mentioned VendorZ is being considered for an on-prem appliance; security wants KMS + attestation. Also they flagged streaming cutoffs on long table-extraction jobs.
Elsa CSM: Their data lead emailed two failing outputs with missing table rows and duplicated dates. They want repro + remediation steps.
Ivy Eng: Can you paste a sanitized prompt and a request id? Streaming cutoff + duplicate rows sounds like token truncation or chunking misalignment during windowing.
Elsa CSM: Prompt (sanitized):
```
Extract invoice line-items (date, sku, qty, net) from a 12-page PDF thread and output as CSV preserving order.
```
Req id: nb_req_20260510_42
Rohan Solutions: Posted a short comparison doc (Dedicated+KMS vs Private Appliance) with expected time-to-prod and delta cost: https://redwood.internal/nb-compare (internal).
Tom AE: Proposed next steps: 1) 30m tech sync with their data lead this week; 2) send KMS/SSO checklist + streaming guidelines; 3) offer a 5-day dedicated trial with telemetry + adjusted chunking config; 4) collect 3 failing prompts & outputs for eval harness. Agree? :thinking_face:
Elsa CSM: +1. I'll collect the 3 prompts and outputs by Tue EOD and loop exec sponsor. Also ask security whether VendorZ is pursuing hardware air-gap vs just KMS.
Ivy Eng: I'll reproduce with their pinned model and run experiments: alternate chunk sizes, overlap policy, and stream buffer limits. Will attach p50/p95 latency and sample diffs to ticket CS-9230.
watchdog-bot: Health-scan: NorthBridge (org_id: nb_782) flagged LOW_USAGE; risk_score=16/100; flagged_by=engagement-monitor.
Tom AE: I'll draft the re-engagement email and invite procurement + security. Elsa, once prompts are uploaded I'll append logs and Ivy's perf notes.
Elsa CSM: Scheduling now. Will update after the call. :white_check_mark:
